topic: Tier list: the exhaust decisions that actually matter

slides.headline: The exhaust decisions that actually matter.
slides.subline: Most kitchens start at F and never find out why.

slides.title: Buying a bigger fan
slides.text: The reflex when extraction fails. It usually makes the pressure worse and leaves the real cause in place. Fix the route first, then size the fan for it.

slides.title: Planning make-up air
slides.text: Replacement air has to be designed in. Without it the fan starves, doors slam and smoke stays at head height. Cheap to plan, expensive to ignore.

slides.title: Getting the hood right
slides.text: Width, overhang and fitting height decide how much smoke ever reaches the duct. The best fan cannot catch what the canopy lets past.

slides.title: Matching fan to the run
slides.text: Not the biggest fan, the right one. Sized to the hood and to the resistance of the real route, not the catalogue headline.

slides.title: The duct route
slides.text: Short, straight and settled before anything is ordered. Get this right and every other choice gets easier. Get it wrong and nothing else saves you.

slides.headline: Rank your own system before you spend.
slides.subline: Send the layout and we will tell you which tier is failing.

caption_en:
Most kitchens fix the exhaust in the wrong order: from the bottom of this list up. That is why the same problem returns.

F is buying a bigger fan. It feels decisive, it rarely fixes anything, and it often makes the pressure worse.

A, B and C are the parts that do the work: make-up air, the hood, and a fan matched to the real run. Most systems improve the moment those three are treated as one design.

S is the duct route. Short, straight, decided before anything is ordered. Invisible, and it decides everything downstream.

caption_ar:
معظم المطابخ تصلح الشفط بالترتيب الخطأ: تبدأ من أسفل القائمة وتصعد، ولهذا يعود نفس المشكلة.

التقييم F هو شراء مروحة أكبر. يبدو قراراً حاسماً، لكنه نادراً ما يحل شيئاً، وغالباً يزيد الضغط سوءاً.

أما A وB وC فهي الأجزاء التي تقوم بالعمل: هواء التعويض، والغطاء، ومروحة بمقاس المسار الحقيقي. معظم الأنظمة تتحسن بمجرد التعامل مع هذه الثلاثة كتصميم واحد.

والتقييم S هو مسار القناة: قصير ومستقيم ويُحسم قبل طلب أي شيء. ممل وغير مرئي، لكنه يحدد كل ما يأتي بعده.
